title: MECCHA CHAMELEON
provenance: Reported by moffatluke (highball-db#105, 2026-09-17), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.0 as entered, Highball 0.9.19, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r3, D3DMetal (per the follow-up), rated 3 of 5 (playable with workarounds) after 1 minute. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable with workarounds on D3DMetal (Unreal Engine, Direct3D 12). The game's bundled launcher PenguinHotel.exe refuses to start with a 'Visual C++ 2015-2022 Redistributable is required' dialog although the runtime is installed, then hangs at sign-in with a missing authentication token. The reporter got past both by setting native,builtin overrides for msvcp140, msvcp140_1, msvcp140_2, vcruntime140 and vcruntime140_1 (the same overrides Highball's Visual C++ component sets when it installs the runtime itself) and by pointing Steam's launch options straight at Chameleon/Binaries/Win64/PenguinHotel-Win64-Shipping.exe with %command% -windowed, which skips the launcher. Only one minute played, so the game starting and rendering is all this says. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: Launcher says the Visual C++ 2015-2022 runtime is missing although it is installed, then hangs at sign-in
knownIssues.cause: The launcher checks the runtime DLLs and finds Wine's built-in copies when the runtime was installed by Steam's redist step rather than by Highball's component, which sets native overrides
knownIssues.fix: Install the Visual C++ runtimes from Environment settings, Windows components (sets the overrides), and in Steam's launch options for the game put the full path to Chameleon\Binaries\Win64\PenguinHotel-Win64-Shipping.exe followed by %command% -windowed to skip the launcher (reported by the community)
